title: Allowable service load.
officialText:
The allowable service load for headed anchors in shear or tension shall be as indicated in Table
1911.2. Where anchors are subject to combined shear and tension, the following relationship shall be satisfied:
(P /P )5/3 + (V / V )5/3 ≤ 1 (Equation 19-1)
s t s t
where:
P = Applied tension service load, pounds (N).
s
P = Allowable tension service load from Table 1911.2, pounds (N).
t
V = Applied shear service load, pounds (N).
s
V = Allowable shear service load from Table 1911.2, pounds (N).
t
